tier_should.rationale: Innovative, rigorous integration of AI into growth with task-based mechanics and elasticity insights; clarifies capital- vs labor-augmenting effects. Highly relevant and original, but minimal empirics likely preclude certain top-five general acceptance.

tier_will.rationale: Star authors and NBER platform raise visibility; theoretical, speculative emphasis and limited empirics point to top field or elite review venues (AEJ Macro, JEP, BPEA) rather than assured top-five general.
